1|"""trimtok CCR: Unified Two-Tier Content-Addressed Retrieval Store with Zstandard compression.
2|
3|Tier 1 — in-memory LRU (OrderedDict, 512 entries).
4|Tier 2 — ONE SQLite WAL database in ~/.trimtok/, replacing thousands of per-slice files.
5|Refs are short Base62 aliases (#c1, #c2, ...); legacy 12-hex digests keep resolving.
6|
7|Also supports directory-parameterized file-based operations (for testing/seaming).
8|Never raises: every entry point fails open gracefully.
9|"""
10|
11|from __future__ import annotations
12|
13|import hashlib
14|import os
15|import re
16|import sqlite3
17|import tempfile
18|import threading
19|import time
20|from collections import OrderedDict
21|from pathlib import Path
22|from typing import Any
23|
24|# Optional Zstandard compression
25|_ZSTD_AVAILABLE = False
26|_ZSTD_CCTX = None
27|_ZSTD_DCTX = None
28|try:
29|    import zstandard as zstd
30|    _ZSTD_CCTX = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3)
31|    _ZSTD_DCTX = zstd.ZstdDecompressor()
32|    _ZSTD_AVAILABLE = True
33|except Exception:
34|    pass
35|
36|import zlib
37|
38|_BASE62 = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
39|_MAX_MEM_ITEMS = 512
40|_HEX12_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{12,64}$")
41|_LOCK = threading.Lock()
42|_GLOBAL_STORE: FastCCRStore | None = None
43|
44|_PUT_COUNT = 0
45|_FILE_MEM_LRU: OrderedDict[tuple[Path, str], tuple[str, float]] = OrderedDict()
46|

48|def default_dir() -> Path:
49|    """Canonical store directory: TRIMTOK_DATA_DIR > ~/.trimtok.
50|
51|    Auto-migrates legacy Hermes plugin data if ~/.trimtok is not yet present.
52|    """
53|    if os.environ.get("TRIMTOK_DATA_DIR"):
54|        return Path(os.environ["TRIMTOK_DATA_DIR"]).expanduser()
55|
56|    home = Path(os.path.expanduser("~"))
57|    canonical_dir = home / ".trimtok"
58|
59|    if not canonical_dir.exists():
60|        legacy_candidates = []
61|        if os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA"):
62|            legacy_candidates.append(Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "hermes" / "plugin-data" / "trimtok")
63|        legacy_candidates.append(home / ".hermes" / "plugin-data" / "trimtok")
64|        for legacy in legacy_candidates:
65|            if legacy.is_dir() and any(legacy.iterdir()):
66|                try:
67|                    import shutil
68|                    canonical_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
69|                    shutil.copytree(legacy, canonical_dir, dirs_exist_ok=True)
70|                    break
71|                except Exception:
72|                    pass
73|
74|    return canonical_dir
75|
76|
77|def _to_base62(num: int) -> str:
78|    if num <= 0:
79|        return "0"
80|    out = []
81|    while num:
82|        num, rem = divmod(num, 62)
83|        out.append(_BASE62[rem])
84|    return "".join(reversed(out))
85|
86|
87|def _compress_payload(content_str: str) -> bytes | str:
88|    """Compress content with zstd or zlib if size > 1500 chars, else keep str."""
89|    raw = content_str.encode("utf-8")
90|    if len(raw) < 1500:
91|        return content_str
92|    if _ZSTD_AVAILABLE and _ZSTD_CCTX is not None:
93|        try:
94|            with _LOCK:
95|                return b"zstd:" + _ZSTD_CCTX.compress(raw)
96|        except Exception:
97|            pass
98|    try:
99|        return b"zlib:" + zlib.compress(raw, level=6)
100|    except Exception:
101|        return content_str
102|
103|
104|def _decompress_payload(stored: Any) -> str | None:
105|    """Decompress zstd, zlib, or raw str content."""
106|    if stored is None:
107|        return None
108|    if isinstance(stored, str):
109|        return stored
110|    if isinstance(stored, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
111|        b = bytes(stored)
112|        if b.startswith(b"zstd:") and _ZSTD_AVAILABLE and _ZSTD_DCTX is not None:
113|            try:
114|                with _LOCK:
115|                    return _ZSTD_DCTX.decompress(b[5:]).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
116|            except Exception:
117|                pass
118|        if b.startswith(b"zlib:"):
119|            try:
120|                return zlib.decompress(b[5:]).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
121|            except Exception:
122|                pass
123|        try:
124|            return b.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
125|        except Exception:
126|            return None
127|    return str(stored)
128|
129|
130|def _is_hex_digest(s: str) -> bool:
131|    """True if s looks like a hex content digest (>=8 hex chars)."""
132|    return len(s) >= 8 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in s.lower())

135|class FastCCRStore:
136|    """Two-Tier content-addressed store: RAM LRU + SQLite WAL with Base62 aliases."""
137|
138|    def __init__(self, db_dir: Path | None = None, max_mem_items: int = _MAX_MEM_ITEMS) -> None:
139|        self.base = Path(db_dir) if db_dir else default_dir()
140|        self.db_path = self.base / "trimtok_ccr_v2.sqlite3"
141|        self.max_mem_items = max_mem_items
142|        self._lock = threading.Lock()
143|        self._mem: OrderedDict[str, str] = OrderedDict()
144|        self._alias_mem: dict[str, str] = {}
145|        self._sha_alias: dict[str, str] = {}
146|        self._conn: sqlite3.Connection | None = None
147|        self._alias_seq = 0
148|        self._writable = False
149|        try:
150|            self.base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
151|            self._conn = sqlite3.connect(
152|                str(self.db_path), check_same_thread=False, timeout=10.0, isolation_level=None
153|            )
154|            cur = self._conn.cursor()
155|            cur.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;")
156|            cur.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL;")
157|            cur.execute("PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY;")
158|            cur.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=10000;")
159|            cur.execute("PRAGMA journal_size_limit=4194304;")
160|            cur.execute("PRAGMA wal_autocheckpoint=100;")
161|            cur.execute(
162|                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chunks ("
163|                " sha TEXT PRIMARY KEY, alias TEXT UNIQUE, content BLOB, created_at REAL)"
164|            )
165|            # Migrate legacy schema (sha12 column) to new (sha) column.
166|            try:
167|                cols = {r[1] for r in cur.execute("PRAGMA table_info(chunks)").fetchall()}
168|                if "sha" not in cols and "sha12" in cols:
169|                    cur.execute("ALTER TABLE chunks RENAME COLUMN sha12 TO sha;")
170|            except Exception:
171|                pass
172|            cur.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alias ON chunks(alias);")
173|            cur.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT);")
174|            row = cur.execute("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='alias_seq'").fetchone()
175|            self._alias_seq = int(row[0]) if row and str(row[0]).isdigit() else 0
176|            self._writable = True
177|        except Exception:
178|            self._conn = None
179|
180|    def close(self) -> None:
181|        with self._lock:
182|            if self._conn is not None:
183|                try:
184|                    self._conn.execute("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);")
185|                except Exception:
186|                    pass
187|                try:
188|                    self._conn.close()
189|                except Exception:
190|                    pass
191|                self._conn = None
192|
193|    def put(self, content: str, *, ttl_hours: int = 24) -> str:
194|        """Store content, return Base62 alias (e.g. #c1). Never raises."""
195|        if not content:
196|            return ""
197|        sha = hashlib.sha256(content.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
198|        with self._lock:
199|            if sha in self._sha_alias:
200|                alias = self._sha_alias[sha]
201|                self._mem.move_to_end(sha)
202|                return alias
203|
204|            if not self._writable or self._conn is None:
205|                # Fail open: never emit a retrieval marker that cannot be
206|                # resolved after a process restart (in-memory-only alias).
207|                return ""
208|
209|            try:
210|                cur = self._conn.cursor()
211|                cur.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
212|                row = cur.execute("SELECT alias FROM chunks WHERE sha=?", (sha,)).fetchone()
213|                if row:
214|                    alias = row[0]
215|                    cur.execute("COMMIT")
216|                    self._set_mem(sha, alias, content)
217|                    return alias
218|
219|                cur.execute(
220|                    "INSERT INTO meta (key, value) VALUES ('alias_seq', '1') "
221|                    "ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = CAST(CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1 AS TEXT)"
222|                )
223|                seq_row = cur.execute("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='alias_seq'").fetchone()
224|                seq_num = int(seq_row[0]) if seq_row and str(seq_row[0]).isdigit() else 1
225|                self._alias_seq = max(self._alias_seq, seq_num)
226|                alias = f"#c{_to_base62(seq_num)}"
227|
228|                now = time.time()
229|                stored_blob = _compress_payload(content)
230|                cur.execute(
231|                    "INSERT INTO chunks (sha, alias, content, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
232|                    "ON CONFLICT(sha) DO UPDATE SET content=excluded.content, created_at=excluded.created_at",
233|                    (sha, alias, stored_blob, now),
234|                )
235|                # Opportunistic TTL sweep (at most once every 50 writes)
236|                if ttl_hours > 0 and (seq_num % 50 == 0):
237|                    expire_before = now - (ttl_hours * 3600.0)
238|                    cur.execute("DELETE FROM chunks WHERE created_at < ?", (expire_before,))
239|
240|                cur.execute("COMMIT")
241|                self._set_mem(sha, alias, content)
242|                return alias
243|            except Exception:
244|                try:
245|                    self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
246|                except Exception:
247|                    pass
248|                # Strict fail-open: never emit an unresolvable in-memory alias!
249|                return ""
250|
251|    def get(self, ref: str, *, ttl_hours: int = 24) -> str | None:
252|        """Retrieve original content by #ref (e.g. #c1) or sha hash."""
253|        if not ref:
254|            return None
255|        target = ref.strip()
256|        if re.match(r"^c[0-9A-Za-z]+$", target) and len(target) <= 8:
257|            target = f"#{target}"
258|        with self._lock:
259|            # A "#<hex>" ref may be a digest (content hash) rather than a CCR
260|            # alias; resolve by sha prefix in that case.
261|            is_alias = target.startswith("#") and not _is_hex_digest(target.lstrip("#"))
262|            if is_alias:
263|                sha = self._alias_mem.get(target)
264|            else:
265|                sha = target.lstrip("#")
266|            if sha and sha in self._mem and ttl_hours >= 24:
267|                self._mem.move_to_end(sha)
268|                return self._mem[sha]
269|
270|            if not self._writable or self._conn is None:
271|                return self._mem.get(sha) if sha else None
272|
273|            try:
274|                cur = self._conn.cursor()
275|                if is_alias:
276|                    row = cur.execute(
277|                        "SELECT sha, alias, content, created_at FROM chunks WHERE alias=?",
278|                        (target,),
279|                    ).fetchone()
280|                elif len(sha) < 64:
281|                    row = cur.execute(
282|                        "SELECT sha, alias, content, created_at FROM chunks WHERE substr(sha,1,?)=?",
283|                        (len(sha), sha),
284|                    ).fetchone()
285|                else:
286|                    row = cur.execute(
287|                        "SELECT sha, alias, content, created_at FROM chunks WHERE sha=?",
288|                        (sha,),
289|                    ).fetchone()
290|
291|                if row:
292|                    sha, row_alias, blob, created_at = row[0], row[1], row[2], row[3]
293|                    if (
294|                        ttl_hours > 0
295|                        and created_at is not None
296|                        and (time.time() - float(created_at)) > (ttl_hours * 3600.0)
297|                    ):
298|                        cur.execute("DELETE FROM chunks WHERE sha=?", (sha,))
299|                        self._conn.commit()
300|                        self._mem.pop(sha, None)
301|                        self._sha_alias.pop(sha, None)
302|                        if row_alias:
303|                            self._alias_mem.pop(row_alias, None)
304|                        return None
305|                    decomp = _decompress_payload(blob)
306|                    if decomp is not None:
307|                        alias = row_alias or (target if target.startswith("#") else f"#{sha}")
308|                        self._set_mem(sha, alias, decomp)
309|                        return decomp
310|            except Exception:
311|                return None
312|        return None
313|
314|    def _set_mem(self, sha: str, alias: str, content: str) -> None:
315|        self._mem[sha] = content
316|        self._alias_mem[alias] = sha
317|        self._sha_alias[sha] = alias
318|        while len(self._mem) > self.max_mem_items:
319|            old_sha, _ = self._mem.popitem(last=False)
320|            old_alias = self._sha_alias.pop(old_sha, None)
321|            if old_alias:
322|                self._alias_mem.pop(old_alias, None)
323|
324|    def stats(self) -> dict[str, int]:
325|        """Total entries and bytes cached."""
326|        count = 0
327|        total_bytes = 0
328|        with self._lock:
329|            if self._writable and self._conn is not None:
330|                try:
331|                    cur = self._conn.cursor()
332|                    row = cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(LENGTH(content)) FROM chunks").fetchone()
333|                    count = row[0] or 0
334|                    total_bytes = row[1] or 0
335|                except Exception:
336|                    pass
337|            if not count:
338|                count = len(self._mem)
339|                total_bytes = sum(len(v) for v in self._mem.values())
340|        return {"entries": count, "bytes": total_bytes}
341|
342|    def purge(self, *, before_seconds: float = 0) -> int:
343|        """Purge stored chunks (all when before_seconds <= 0, or older than before_seconds)."""
344|        count = 0
345|        with self._lock:
346|            if before_seconds <= 0:
347|                self._mem.clear()
348|                self._alias_mem.clear()
349|                self._sha_alias.clear()
350|            if self._writable and self._conn is not None:
351|                try:
352|                    cur = self._conn.cursor()
353|                    if before_seconds > 0:
354|                        cutoff = time.time() - before_seconds
355|                        rows = cur.execute(
356|                            "SELECT sha, alias FROM chunks WHERE created_at < ?",
357|                            (cutoff,),
358|                        ).fetchall()
359|                        count = len(rows)
360|                        for sha, alias in rows:
361|                            self._mem.pop(sha, None)
362|                            self._sha_alias.pop(sha, None)
363|                            if alias:
364|                                self._alias_mem.pop(alias, None)
365|                        cur.execute("DELETE FROM chunks WHERE created_at < ?", (cutoff,))
366|                    else:
367|                        row = cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chunks").fetchone()
368|                        count = row[0] or 0
369|                        cur.execute("DELETE FROM chunks")
370|                    self._conn.commit()
371|                    self._conn.execute("VACUUM")
372|                except Exception:
373|                    try:
374|                        self._conn.rollback()
375|                    except Exception:
376|                        pass
377|        return count
378|

380|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
381|# File-Based CCR Operations (Legacy & Seaming support when dir is passed)
382|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
383|def _file_put(
384|    content: str,
385|    base: Path,
386|    max_entries: int = 1000,
387|    max_bytes: int = 50 * 1024 * 1024,
388|    ttl_hours: int = 24,
389|) -> str:
390|    global _PUT_COUNT
391|    temp_path: Path | None = None
392|    try:
393|        base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
394|        data = content.encode("utf-8", "replace")
395|        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:12]
396|        path = base / (digest + ".txt")
397|        if not path.exists():
398|            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
399|                mode="wb", dir=base, prefix=f".{digest}.", suffix=".tmp", delete=False
400|            ) as f:
401|                temp_path = Path(f.name)
402|                f.write(data)
403|                f.flush()
404|            os.replace(temp_path, path)
405|            temp_path = None
406|        with _LOCK:
407|            _PUT_COUNT += 1
408|            _FILE_MEM_LRU[(base, digest)] = (content, time.time())
409|            _FILE_MEM_LRU.move_to_end((base, digest))
410|            if len(_FILE_MEM_LRU) > _MAX_MEM_ITEMS:
411|                _FILE_MEM_LRU.popitem(last=False)
412|            if _PUT_COUNT % 16 == 0:
413|                _file_evict(base, max_entries, max_bytes, ttl_hours)
414|        return digest
415|    except Exception:
416|        if temp_path is not None:
417|            try:
418|                temp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
419|            except Exception:
420|                pass
421|        return ""
422|
423|
424|def _file_get(digest: str, base: Path, ttl_hours: int = 24) -> str | None:
425|    try:
426|        clean = "".join(c for c in (digest or "") if c in "0123456789abcdef")[:16]
427|        if not clean:
428|            return None
429|        direct = base / (clean + ".txt")
430|        if direct.is_file():
431|            match = direct
432|        else:
433|            matches = sorted(base.glob(clean + "*.txt"))
434|            if len(matches) != 1:
435|                return None
436|            match = matches[0]
437|        cutoff = time.time() - max(0, ttl_hours) * 3600
438|        st = match.stat()
439|        if st.st_mtime < cutoff:
440|            match.unlink(missing_ok=True)
441|            with _LOCK:
442|                _FILE_MEM_LRU.pop((base, match.stem), None)
443|            return None
444|        key = (base, match.stem)
445|        with _LOCK:
446|            if key in _FILE_MEM_LRU and _FILE_MEM_LRU[key][1] >= st.st_mtime:
447|                _FILE_MEM_LRU.move_to_end(key)
448|                return _FILE_MEM_LRU[key][0]
449|        text = match.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
450|        with _LOCK:
451|            _FILE_MEM_LRU[key] = (text, st.st_mtime)
452|            _FILE_MEM_LRU.move_to_end(key)
453|            if len(_FILE_MEM_LRU) > _MAX_MEM_ITEMS:
454|                _FILE_MEM_LRU.popitem(last=False)
455|        return text
456|    except Exception:
457|        return None
458|
459|
460|def _file_evict(base: Path, max_entries: int, max_bytes: int, ttl_hours: int) -> None:
461|    try:
462|        cutoff = time.time() - (ttl_hours * 3600)
463|        files = []
464|        for p in base.glob("*.txt"):
465|            try:
466|                st = p.stat()
467|                if st.st_mtime < cutoff:
468|                    p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
469|                else:
470|                    files.append((p, st))
471|            except Exception:
472|                pass
473|        files.sort(key=lambda t: t[1].st_mtime)
474|        while len(files) > max_entries:
475|            p, _ = files.pop(0)
476|            p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
477|        total = sum(st.st_size for _, st in files)
478|        while files and total > max_bytes:
479|            p, st = files.pop(0)
480|            p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
481|            total -= st.st_size
482|    except Exception:
483|        pass
484|
485|
486|def _file_stats(base: Path, ttl_hours: int = 24) -> dict[str, int]:
487|    try:
488|        if not base.exists():
489|            return {"entries": 0, "bytes": 0}
490|        cutoff = time.time() - max(0, ttl_hours) * 3600
491|        files = []
492|        for p in base.glob("*.txt"):
493|            try:
494|                st = p.stat()
495|                if st.st_mtime < cutoff:
496|                    p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
497|                else:
498|                    files.append((p, st))
499|            except Exception:
500|                pass
501|        return {"entries": len(files), "bytes": sum(st.st_size for _, st in files)}
502|    except Exception:
503|        return {"entries": 0, "bytes": 0}
504|
505|
506|def _file_purge(base: Path, before_seconds: float = 0) -> int:
507|    try:
508|        if not base.exists():
509|            return 0
510|        now = time.time()
511|        purged = 0
512|        for p in base.glob("*.txt"):
513|            if before_seconds <= 0 or (now - p.stat().st_mtime) > before_seconds:
514|                p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
515|                with _LOCK:
516|                    _FILE_MEM_LRU.pop((base, p.stem), None)
517|                purged += 1
518|        return purged
519|    except Exception:
520|        return 0

523|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
524|# Public Facade
525|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
526|def _get_store(base_dir: Path | None = None) -> FastCCRStore:
527|    target = Path(base_dir) if base_dir else default_dir()
528|    global _GLOBAL_STORE
529|    if _GLOBAL_STORE is None or _GLOBAL_STORE.base != target:
530|        with _LOCK:
531|            if _GLOBAL_STORE is None or _GLOBAL_STORE.base != target:
532|                if _GLOBAL_STORE is not None:
533|                    _GLOBAL_STORE.close()
534|                _GLOBAL_STORE = FastCCRStore(target)
535|    return _GLOBAL_STORE
536|
537|
538|def close(dir: Path | None = None) -> None:
539|    global _GLOBAL_STORE
540|    with _LOCK:
541|        if _GLOBAL_STORE is not None:
542|            if dir is None or _GLOBAL_STORE.base == Path(dir):
543|                _GLOBAL_STORE.close()
544|                _GLOBAL_STORE = None
545|
546|
547|def put(content: str, *, dir: Path | None = None, ttl_hours: int = 24, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
548|    """Store content, return alias ref or digest. Never raises."""
549|    try:
550|        if dir is not None:
551|            return _file_put(content, Path(dir), ttl_hours=ttl_hours, **kwargs)
552|        return _get_store().put(content, ttl_hours=ttl_hours)
553|    except Exception:
554|        return ""
555|
556|
557|def get(ref: str, *, dir: Path | None = None, ttl_hours: int = 24, **kwargs: Any) -> str | None:
558|    """Retrieve content by #c... alias or 12-char hex digest."""
559|    try:
560|        if not ref:
561|            return None
562|        target = ref.strip()
563|        base = Path(dir) if dir else default_dir()
564|        is_alias = target.startswith("#c") or bool(re.match(r"^c[0-9A-Za-z]+$", target) and len(target) <= 8)
565|        if is_alias:
566|            return _get_store(base).get(target, ttl_hours=ttl_hours)
567|
568|        # For hex digests: check SQLite store first, only fall back to _file_get if not in SQLite
569|        store_res = _get_store(base).get(target, ttl_hours=ttl_hours)
570|        if store_res is not None:
571|            return store_res
572|        return _file_get(target, base, ttl_hours=ttl_hours)
573|    except Exception:
574|        return None
575|
576|
577|def stats(*, dir: Path | None = None, ttl_hours: int = 24, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, int]:
578|    try:
579|        if dir is not None:
580|            return _file_stats(Path(dir), ttl_hours=ttl_hours)
581|        return _get_store().stats()
582|    except Exception:
583|        return {"entries": 0, "bytes": 0}
584|
585|
586|
587|def purge(*, dir: Path | None = None, before_seconds: float = 0, **kwargs: Any) -> int:

589|        if dir is not None:
